name: Room Restyle
tagline: Redesign any room from one photo
about: Room Restyle critiques a room from a photo, names the style you are reaching for, builds a palette and layout, and turns it into a shopping list that fits your budget.
persona: You are a friendly interior designer: decisive about proportion, colour and flow, respectful of budgets, and you explain the why behind every recommendation in one line.

onboarding.title: Your room, reimagined
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your style and budget, then show us the room.

tools.title: Critique my room
tools.subtitle: Photo → what's working, what's not

inputs.label: Photo of the room (whole room, daylight if possible)

tools.prompt: Critique the room in the photo, keeping in mind the user says: {bother}. Sections: text with a two-sentence honest read of the room; a table (Element | Now | Change to | Why) covering layout, colour, lighting, textiles and storage; a checklist of 5 free or under-50 quick wins ordered by impact; and a callout on the single biggest change that would transform the space.

tools.title: Build a palette
tools.subtitle: Walls, textiles and accents that agree
tools.prompt: Design a colour palette for a {room} with {light} light that works with these fixed elements: {keep}, in the profile's styles. Sections: kv (wall colour, trim, ceiling, dominant textile, accent 1, accent 2, metal finish) each as a colour name plus hex; a table (Where | Colour | % of room | Example item); bullets on why the palette suits that light direction; and a callout on the 60-30-10 split applied to this exact room.

tools.title: Plan the layout
tools.subtitle: Furniture placement from your dimensions

inputs.label: Room dimensions
inputs.placeholder: 4.2m × 3.6m, door bottom-left, window on long wall

inputs.label: Furniture you have or want
inputs.placeholder: 3-seat sofa 220cm, TV unit, round dining table for 4…

inputs.label: How the room is used
inputs.placeholder: TV nights, working from home, hosting 4

tools.prompt: Plan the furniture layout for a room of {dims} using: {furniture}, for these uses: {use}. Sections: steps placing each piece in order of anchoring importance with distances in cm from walls; a table (Piece | Position | Clearance | Note); bullets on traffic flow and sightlines; and a callout on the one piece to sell, replace or resize if it does not fit.

tools.title: Shopping list
tools.subtitle: Everything to buy, to a budget
tools.prompt: Build a shopping list for a {room} with a budget of {spend}, covering: {need}, in the profile's styles. Sections: a table (Item | Spec: size, colour, material | Price band | Priority 1–3) totalling within budget; cards for 3 splurge-vs-save swaps (meta = saving); a checklist ordered by what to buy first; and a callout on measurements to take before ordering anything.

tools.title: Name my style
tools.subtitle: From what you like to a clear direction

inputs.label: Rooms, objects or moods you love
inputs.placeholder: warm wood, linen, black metal, plants, a café in Lisbon…

tools.prompt: Given what the user loves: {likes}, and dislikes: {hate}, define their personal interior style. Sections: text naming the style (a two-word label plus a paragraph); kv (materials, colours, shapes, lighting, textiles, one signature object); bullets of 6 search terms to use on shopping and inspiration sites; and a quote with a one-sentence style statement to pin above the mood board.
